problem.statement: Given the retrieved CRM profile and conversation history for Lead L-48213, classify the Lead as Hot, Warm, or Cold.

hypothesis.statement: Lead is Hot — replied within 2 minutes and asked for a test drive slot
Lead is Warm — engaged but no explicit purchase intent signal

alternatives.rejected_reason: Explicit test-drive request in conversation outweighs the Warm-tier engagement-only signal
Lead has active two-way conversation within the last hour, contradicting Cold criteria

decision.rationale: Test-drive request combined with sub-2-minute reply latency meets the Hot threshold per knowledge.qualification_policy.v1.
